title: Rote Grütze (Red Pudding)
ingredients: Any red fruit, fresh or frozen (typically cherries or red currants)
vanilla pudding, whipped cream or ice cream
instructions: Cook fruit on stovetop with sugar (or honey)
Add cornstarch to make it into a thicker, jam/pudding consistency.
Add whatever topping you’d like, serve hot or cold.
story: Rote Grütze (literally, red pudding) is a typical German dessert that is very simple to make. It can be served hot or cold and enjoyed year-round (personally, I prefer it cold with vanilla sauce). While homemade is always best, my sister and I ate more than our fair share of the store-bought stuff during summer visits to our grandparents in Germany.
